$comment: Template for a PUBLISHED design system package. For in-repo mode you only need the scripts block. Every field below is one that breaks consumers when it is wrong — see the packaging-distribution skill.
name: @acme/ui
description: Acme design system — React components, design tokens and theming

scripts.inventory:build: npm run registry && vite build --config inventory/vite.config.ts
scripts.verify: npm run tokens && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run registry:check
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run verify && npm run build && publint && attw --pack

$notes.sideEffects: MUST list CSS. `false` makes bundlers tree-shake the stylesheet away — the library that renders unstyled in production and works locally.
$notes.peerDependencies: React is NEVER a dependency. Two copies of React is an instant hook-error crash.
$notes.exports: `types` goes FIRST in every condition. Conditions resolve in order, and if `import` wins, consumers silently get `any`.
$notes.versions: Pinned at the time of writing. Run `npm outdated` before adopting — and pin the PRIMITIVE library exactly, since a minor bump can change focus order in ways no type error catches.
